title: CSIS Beyond Parallel — 'Suspected Uranium Enrichment Building at Yongbyon Complete'
snippet: Satellite imagery confirms completion of building at Yongbyon believed to be new uranium enrichment plant. Construction began mid-December 2024, externally complete by early June 2025, internal construction continuing. Located 480m NNE of Radiochemistry Laboratory, 1,800m N of existing centrifuge halls. Generators, fuel storage tanks, cooling units and support buildings confirmed.
tag_reason: CSIS Beyond Parallel의 Yongbyon 농축시설 완공 확인 분석. 이전 7일 소스에서 Vertic/WSJ/IAEA 인용 보도는 있었으나, Beyond Parallel의 위성사진 기반 독립 분석은 처음 등장.
